Notes: Andersen's dakʰ- 'to see' head compares RV √dr̥ś and Pali dassati/dakkhiti and records Maski dakhitaviye. Turner 6507 *dr̥kṣati, branch 1, explicitly lists Pali dakkhati and Ashokan dakhati with gerundive dakhitaviye 'sees'. Andersen directly attested seeing and growing verbs

Andersen's vadʰ- 'to increase, grow' head compares RV vardhati and Pali vaḍḍhati and records the Ashokan future vaḍhisiti/vaḍhisati series. Turner 11376 várdhatē directly lists Pali vaḍḍhati, Ashokan vaḍhiśati future and vaḍhati. Andersen directly attested seeing and growing verbs
